affected_rows: the 'Penyumbang Utama Hasil' rows of CMD.34.2019 (J11) and CMD.37.2018 (J4.10)
defect: The table prints two totals: 'JUMLAH HASIL RM421.24 Juta' (ALL revenue, in the header) and 'JUMLAH PENYUMBANG UTAMA HASIL' (the five lines). The check compares the five lines with the first; in CMD.37.2018 the (%) column (88.8) is also read as an amount, as in Selangor's table.
why_unfixed: Take the JUMLAH PENYUMBANG UTAMA line as the total and pair columns by x-position; re-extraction pending.
impact_on_data: Analysis-table rows only; core and the gap view do not use them.

defect: `revenue_top_contributors_total` carries TOTAL REVENUE (413.46 / 421.24) instead of the top-five subtotal (367.27 / 382.59).
diagnosis: The table prints a banner row `JUMLAH HASIL   RM421.24 Juta` above the contributor list as well as the real subtotal `JUMLAH PENYUMBANG UTAMA HASIL   382.59`.  Both labels open with `JUMLAH`, so the dictionary's `^jumlah\b -> revenue_top_contributors_total` rule matched the banner first.  The five contributor lines are correct and sum to the printed 382.59 exactly (128.72 + 121.50 + 56.87 + 38.49 + 37.01).
why_unfixed: Needs a TABLE-level rule (`JUMLAH HASIL` is total revenue only when the same table also prints a `JUMLAH PENYUMBANG UTAMA` row).  The label-level rule was tried and reverted: it regressed 15 other states' tables, where `JUMLAH HASIL` IS the top-five caption.
impact_on_data: Two `revenue_top_contributors_total` values are total revenue.  No contributor item is affected; no figure was altered.  N7 (subtotal <= revenue) still passes because the value IS the revenue total.

defect: The FY2017 top-five subtotal reads 88.8 - the printed PERCENTAGE - instead of the printed 367.27 RM juta.
diagnosis: The JUMLAH row is typeset with its own spacing (`JUMLAH      367.27       88.8            341.92    89.9`), so its tokens sit left of the column grid the contributor rows establish and the FY2017 money cell picked up the percent token.  The FY2016 cell (341.92) and all five contributor rows are correct.
why_unfixed: Same root cause as the Selangor entries below - a printed JUMLAH row set to its own measure in an interleaved `(RM Juta)`/`(%)` matrix.  Fixing it needs the row-level ordinal fallback to be re-derived from the money columns alone, which touches every trend table in the source.
impact_on_data: One `revenue_top_contributors_total` value is a percentage.  The conformed contributor items (`revenue_item_*`) on this page are unaffected.

affected_rows: unknown - a latent tokeniser defect, not a located row set
defect: A figure printed EXACTLY ONE SPACE after the previous figure is dropped by `lkan_state_parser._value_tokens`.
diagnosis: `_NUM_RE` allows one optional space after the sign, so when two figures are one space apart the scanner starts the second match ON that space; its preceding character is then the last digit of the first figure and the date / section-number guard discards it.  Seen on Sarawak CMD.43.2018 J4.14, where every row lost `27.5 25.8 35.2`.
why_unfixed: The root fix (trim leading white space before applying the guard) was implemented and DELIBERATELY REVERTED: it moved roughly 2,000 rows across all 13 states, raised the refusal count, and degraded the frozen Selangor regression.  It needs its own pass with the column clustering retuned alongside it.
impact_on_data: Mostly percentage and PERUBAHAN columns, which are not extracted anyway.  Where it hits a money column the row is marked `column_geometry=incomplete_row`, so no figure is wrong - some are absent.
